behavior.auditQueryEndpoint: GET /api/workspaces/:organizationId/operations/audit implemented with OWNER/ADMIN role authorization; non-privileged roles (EDITOR, CREATOR, ANALYST, CLIENT) rejected with 403; non-members rejected with 404
behavior.queryFiltering: Supports filtering by action prefix, actorId, startDate, and endDate, with bounded cursor pagination (take <= 100)
behavior.auditExportEndpoint: GET /api/workspaces/:organizationId/operations/audit-export streams NDJSON manifest, auditLog entries, and complete footer
behavior.tamperEvidentChecksum: Terminal complete record computes SHA-256 over all preceding lines including newlines for immutable compliance verification
behavior.auditTrail: Emits immutable audit.exported event in AuditLog recording actorId, execution timestamp, count, filters, and SHA-256 digest
behavior.tests: 15 unit tests in tests/data-governance.test.ts and comprehensive HTTP integration test in tests/integration/data-export.test.ts verifying query filtering, cursor pagination, 403 authorization rejections, NDJSON export, SHA-256 verification, and audit event creation

limits: Audit log export is scoped strictly to tenant-owned records; system logs and other tenants are isolated
Windows environment limits: full Compose verification runs on Linux CI
